Priya (CS): Kicking off NovaEdge onboarding here. High-level asks from customer: SSO, VPC peering to sandbox, and preserved audit trail for 180 days.
Ben (CSM): I'll own stakeholder map + success criteria. Propose weekly 30-min sync Tues 10am PT.
Nora (NovaEdge): Hi all 12 Nora from NovaEdge. Priority is getting a safe sandbox to validate our QA flows. We also want a short enablement session for our SREs.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll take the tech lead. Need exact payload samples and expected QPS for baseline. Also: do you plan to use embeddings or generation routes primarily?
Nora (NovaEdge): Mainly generation for customer-facing chat, low-latency needed. QPS estimate: 5 p95 spikes to 20.
Talia (Security): I'll shepherd compliance approvals. If NovaEdge requires 180d audit log retention, we need to confirm retention tier and any export requirements. Also: does the tenant have strict IP allowlists?
Priya (CS): Owners: Ben -> Stakeholder comms + renewal watch; Ravi -> Integration lead; Talia -> Compliance sign-off; Priya -> onboarding ops and runbook; Nora -> customer exec + SRE contact.
Ben (CSM): Draft success criteria: - Sandbox reachable from NovaEdge CIDR and SSO auth within 10 days; - E2E integration test passes with p95 < 400ms for chat flows; - Dashboard shows cost per conversation < target; - Enablement session recorded + playbook delivered.
Ravi (Solutions): Proposed minimal timeline:
```
Day 0: Kickoff + collect SSO metadata + CIDRs
Day 3: Sandbox provisioned + peering + smoke auth
Day 7: E2E test + perf baseline
Day 10: Observability + dashboard initial
Day 14: Enablement + handoff
```
Priya (CS): Risks: If security questionnaire requires network segmentation changes, delay could push integration >3 weeks -> raise renewal risk flag. Also, export requests for audit logs may need legal review.
Nora (NovaEdge): We'll fill security questionnaire by EOD today. SRE lead is @Cass (cass@novaedge.io).
ops-bot: Standup created: "NovaEdge Onboarding: Weekly sync" Tuesdays 10:00am PT. Calendar invite sent.
Talia (Security): Quick ask: Cass, can you provide expected traffic origin IPs and whether you're routing through a NAT? Also: any PII in prompts?
Nora (NovaEdge): No PII in prompts. IPs: will share range tomorrow. We route through our NAT.
Ravi (Solutions): Pre-reqs for deep-dive: (1) SAML/OIDC metadata, (2) sample messages (1-2 minute convo), (3) expected token sizes and concurrency.
Ben (CSM): I'll add a renewal checkpoint (90/60/30/14) and flag if compliance extends beyond 14 days.
Priya (CS): I'll create the onboarding checklist doc and share link: https://redwood.docs/onboarding/novaedge-draft (permissions to NovaEdge granted).
Nora (NovaEdge): Thanks 12 we'll upload artifacts to the doc and tag Ben + Ravi.
Ravi (Solutions): Can we schedule a 60-min SRE deep-dive Thurs 9am PT? Discuss VPN/NAT and perf testing harness.
Priya (CS): Works for me. Nora, can Cass join?
Nora (NovaEdge): Yes Cass confirmed.
Talia (Security): I'll do a quick review before Thurs and list any extra controls we need in the doc.
Priya (CS): Next steps: 1) NovaEdge uploads security artifacts (EOD tomorrow), 2) Ravi and Ben prep test plan, 3) Priya publishes runbook + calendar invites. We'll reconvene after Thurs deep-dive to lock Week 1 tasks. :white_check_mark:
